[CONTRIBUTION EVENT]
- Type: Time (Minutes)
- Amount: 540
- Description: Cacao Mass Bar (500g) — ship, launch, and Merchant Center feed compliance
  
  Pull requests (GitHub evidence):
  - https://github.com/TrueSightDAO/agroverse_shop_beta/pull/356
  - https://github.com/TrueSightDAO/agroverse_shop_beta/pull/359
  - https://github.com/TrueSightDAO/agroverse_shop_beta/pull/360
  - https://github.com/TrueSightDAO/agroverse_shop_beta/pull/361
  - https://github.com/TrueSightDAO/agroverse_shop_beta/pull/362
  - https://github.com/TrueSightDAO/agroverse_shop_beta/pull/363
  - https://github.com/TrueSightDAO/agroverse_shop_beta/pull/364
  - https://github.com/TrueSightDAO/agroverse_shop_beta/pull/365
  - https://github.com/TrueSightDAO/agroverse_shop_beta/pull/366
  - https://github.com/TrueSightDAO/agroverse_shop_beta/pull/367
  - https://github.com/TrueSightDAO/agroverse_shop_beta/pull/368
  
  Details:
  End-to-end delivery of the new Cacao Mass Bar (500g) SKU on the Agroverse shop: creation, provenance correction, pricing, storefront surfacing, sold-out demotion, and the feed-compliance work that made the catalog Merchant Center-safe. 11 PRs, all merged to agroverse_shop_beta; verified against live DOM on both beta and production.
  
  WORK COMPLETED (chronological)
  
  1. SKU creation (#356) — new Cacao Mass Bar (500g), Ilhéus Brazil 2024, with product page and products.js entry.
  
  2. Provenance + pricing (#359, #361, #363) — attributed to Oscar's farm; price settled at $60; provenance corrected to AGL4 shipment and the MAIN ledger; courier corrected to the TAP air-freight AWB rather than Correios. Recorded 37-bar stock.
  
  3. Storefront surfacing (#360, #362) — 500g card added to the AGL4 and AGL10 shipment grids.
  
  4. Sold-out rendering bug (#364) — an untracked SKU was rendered as "Out of stock" and had add-to-cart disabled. Root cause: the inventory service treated absence from the snapshot as zero. Fixed so absence means "untracked / check availability" rather than sold out. This was the blocker preventing the 500g bar from being purchasable at all.
  
  5. Past Harvests demotion (#365) — added a section that demotes sold-out lots out of the commerce grid while preserving lineage/provenance, instead of leaving them buyable. Fixed a self-introduced defect in #366 where a second status badge was stacked on top of the existing one, producing three redundant "out of stock" labels per card.
  
  6. Production promotion + verification — synced beta to prod, then verified live agroverse.shop rather than trusting the merge: PDP shows $60.00, "37 in stock", add-to-cart enabled; landing shows 7 cards with 6 working carts, Past Harvests section with 4 demoted lots. Two mid-investigation false alarms were run to ground and reported honestly: an apparent "missing cards" issue was a measurement error (counting one CSS class when cards are injected under a different class), and an apparent stale deploy was a probe that ran ahead of the Pages build.
  
  7. Merchant Center feed compliance (#367) — the highest-risk finding. facebook_product_feed.xml was a committed artifact last built Oct 25 with no generator in any pipeline. Three defects fixed:
     - parse_products_js() matched only the main window.PRODUCTS literal, so annex-style window.PRODUCTS['id'] = {...} assignments were invisible to the parser. Both the newly launched 500g bar and the white-label bar had never reached the feed. Verified by executing the parser directly (500g present? False). 14 -> 16 products parsed.
     - g:availability was hardcoded to 'in stock' for every item while 4 of 9 published items were at zero stock. Availability mismatch is Merchant Center misrepresentation that can suspend an account, not merely disapprove items. Now resolved from the live agroverse-inventory snapshot (same SSOT as inventory-service.js) with timeout and graceful fallback. Absence of a snapshot row remains "in stock" — consistent with #364's absence-not-zero principle.
     - No g:gtin and no g:identifier_exists emitted despite 7 valid GTINs in products.js. Now emits g:gtin when known, else g:identifier_exists=no.
     Result: 9 -> 11 items, 4 false in-stock claims -> 0, 6 GTINs + 5 identifier_exists=no (12 = 11, exactly one stance per item), 0 dead links. Added a guard skipping products with no product-page directory, which caught the white-label bar (slug white-label-chocolate-bar has no page) that the parser fix would otherwise have published as a dead Merchant Center link.
  
  8. Feed ownership / anti-rot hardening (#368) — added tests/feed/test_product_feed.py (11 items, well-formed, exactly one identifier stance per item, no duplicate g:id, every g:link verified against the filesystem rather than the network so CI cannot flake), a structural freshness check that regenerates offline and diffs against committed XML with availability/lastBuildDate deliberately normalized out, a FEED_OFFLINE=1 deterministic mode, and .github/workflows/product-feed-freshness.yml running on product changes plus a daily 06:17 UTC cron. Every test was negative-controlled to prove it can fail.
  
  VERIFICATION METHOD
  All storefront claims were checked by driving Playwright against the live DOM (beta and production), not by reading the repo or trusting an automated tool's "pass" verdict. Feed claims were checked by executing the generator and asserting item counts, per-item availability, identifier coverage, and dead-link count against the filesystem.
  
  OUT OF SCOPE / KNOWN GAPS
  - farm_media_manifests/main/galleries/agl4.json returns 404 on both beta and production (pre-existing, not caused by this work). Cosmetic: breaks only the AGL4 media gallery auto-population.
  - custom-white-label-chocolate-bar-50g has a GTIN and $10 price but no product page. Deliberately excluded from the feed rather than published as a dead link. Separate product-page build.
  - Open question for the governor: whether 37 is the correct sellable count for the 500g bar. It now enforces cart limits in production, so an overstated figure would oversell.
- Contributor(s): Sophia Truesight
- TDG Issued: 900.00
- Attached Filename: N/A
- Destination Contribution File Location: N/A
--------
